top_signals.title: Gold Edges Higher After AI-Driven Selloff as Focus Shifts to Fed
top_signals.summary: Gold edged higher, following a broad AI-led market rout last week, as traders weighed dim chances the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates at its upcoming policy meeting.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Saudi Oil Output Jumps 12.2% to 8 Million Bpd in September
top_signals.summary: Crude oil production in Saudi Arabia rose by 12.2% in September from a month earlier, to reach 8 million barrels per day (bpd), data by Al Rajhi Capital Research cited by TradeArabia showed on Monday. Following the very low levels of crude oil output in the spring and early summer, when all Gulf producers slashed output due to inability to ship crude cargoes via the Strait of Hormuz, production has started to recover as Saudi Arabia boosted ship-to-ship (STS) transfers outside the Strait and redirected most exports through its Red Sea port of Yanbu.…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
